Fields : Risk : 4pts Low Volume of New Inventory Levels : 1pt Low Activity Levels : 1pt Little Current Opportunity Pipeline : 1pt Significant (Trigger) Event : 1pt Poor Contact Levels : 1pt Poor Relationship Quality : 1pt Low Perception of IM Value : 1pt
